digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration and developer gates
propositions: Local developer gates must resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles using layered config file rather than deprecated REBAR_LLM_MODEL
Developer can configure Bedrock opt-in via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE and revert to Anthropic in one step by unsetting the variable
Prompt caching must engage on Bedrock path with nonzero cache_read_tokens across all three gate types (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion)
Structured output must validate and parse on every Bedrock gate run with no INDETERMINATE or unparsed fallback verdicts
Bedrock cachePoint TTL defaults to 5 minutes matching Anthropic cache_control default, with no observable difference in cache behavior between providers
No changes to infra/ directory or src/ behavior are required; configuration is local-only and reversible
